purpose: Metadata-only register of candidate public sources. Nothing was downloaded; no data are included. Every licence_status is unverified or restricted until a person confirms it; none is a licence PASS.

sources.title: Disclosure Archives open UAP dataset
sources.stated_contents: Page states 192 events; fields: title, date, type, location, coordinates, source URL, summary, tags, witnesses. Page says refreshed nightly.
sources.stated_licence: Page: 'Editorial copy and the structure of this dataset are CC-BY 4.0.' Linked primary-source documents keep their publishers' terms.
sources.project_note: Event-level curated catalogue, not raw case reports. Do not mix with case-level data in hit-rate analyses.

sources.title: uap-events-dataset (GitHub mirror of Disclosure Archives)
sources.stated_contents: Files uap-events.csv and uap-events.json; event count not stated on the page.
sources.stated_licence: README: 'The editorial copy and dataset structure are licensed CC BY 4.0.' Linked documents retain their original publisher's terms.
sources.project_note: Mirror of the entry above; treat as the same source, not an independent one. Nightly refresh is claimed, not verified.

sources.title: PURSUE Open Atlas (DoW UFO/UAP Release 01)
sources.stated_contents: Page states 161 records, 130 PDFs/images, 4,153 pages; corpus.jsonl; image captions partly machine-generated.
sources.stated_licence: Page: 'License: CC0 1.0'; source documents described as public domain under 17 U.S.C. 105.
sources.project_note: Document corpus, not sighting cases. Captions are machine-generated and can be wrong.

sources.title: uapinsight PURSUE dataset
sources.stated_contents: Page states 521 documents, 8 releases, 13,248 transcribed pages, data as of 2026-11-22.
sources.stated_licence: README: 'Free to use, share and adapt under CC BY 4.0.' Government documents themselves stated to be U.S. public domain.
sources.project_note: Analysis fields and transcriptions are machine-generated (README: can be wrong). Document corpus, not sighting cases.

sources.title: ufo_data ('Dataset of the Damned')
sources.stated_contents: Combines many third-party sources; page names about 18k records in hatch_udb.json and about 600 in an anonymous PDF timeline; no total given.
sources.stated_licence: Tool: Apache-2.0. Data: no single licence; per-source terms (e.g. GFDL for rr0.org data); page warns commercial use of copyrighted data may need permission.
sources.project_note: Mixed rights per source. Do not use before each component's terms are checked by a person.

sources.title: nuforc_sightings_data
sources.stated_contents: Roughly 100,000+ NUFORC reports; exact count not stated.
sources.stated_licence: Repository states MIT. README warns NUFORC terms of service 'explicitly forbid both scraping and distributing the data'.
sources.project_note: Upstream terms forbid distribution; the repository's MIT licence cannot override them. Not for use without NUFORC permission.

sources.title: NUFORC (Hugging Face, kcimc)
sources.stated_licence: Metadata: 'license: mit'. README says NUFORC claims copyright and the MIT licence may not be the true licence.
sources.project_note: Same upstream-rights problem as the entry above.

sources.title: UFOSINT Explorer
sources.kind: aggregated sightings (SQLite snapshot in GitHub releases)
sources.stated_contents: Page states 702,572 deduplicated records from four databases (UFOCAT, Capella, UPDB, UFO-search); snapshot ufo_public.db about 628 MB.
sources.stated_licence: No open licence stated on the page; 'Source data is licensed by UFOSINT'; a Capella copyright line is shown.
sources.project_note: Aggregate of overlapping sources: records are not independent. Rights unclear.

sources.title: GEIPAN case archive (CNES)
sources.stated_contents: The FAQ page read does not state whether a downloadable dataset exists, its format or case count.
sources.stated_licence: Not determined: the page read gives no licence or reuse terms (a Legal Notice page exists but was not read).
sources.project_note: Entry is a lead, not a dataset: availability and terms still to be established.
